summary.text: Rick LeBorious is the Democratic candidate for the Connecticut House of Representatives, District 59, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he is running against incumbent Carol Hall (R).
He ran for the same seat in 2024, losing to Hall 50.7 percent to 49.3 percent.

paragraphs.text: In the 2024 general election for District 59, Hall received 6,199 votes to LeBorious's 6,021, according to Ballotpedia.

LeBorious's campaign website describes him as a Democratic candidate for the 59th District, which covers Enfield and East Windsor, and as a "listener and fighter for working families, good jobs, education, and stronger communities."
Ballotpedia lists the Connecticut AFL-CIO among his endorsements.
